title: Add RecipesFolderStore observable store
description: Create CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipesFolderStore.swift. An @Observable class that manages a security-scoped bookmark in UserDefaults (key recipesFolderBookmark: Data; recipesFolderName: String). On init, reads and resolves any stored bookmark via URL(resolvingBookmarkData:options:.withSecurityScope). If isStale, clears both UserDefaults keys and sets resolvedFolderURL to nil. Exposes resolvedFolderURL: URL? and folderDisplayName: String?. Provides a method to persist a newly picked URL as a fresh bookmark. Every folder-content read must be bracketed by startAccessingSecurityScopedResource / stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource.
acceptance_criteria: On init resolves stored bookmark; stale bookmark clears UserDefaults and yields nil resolvedFolderURL.
Exposes resolvedFolderURL: URL? and folderDisplayName: String?.
Provides a method to persist a new folder URL as a bookmark.
